items.title: 12.3 Continuity and Discontinuity of Functions (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Assalam o alaikum! Kitab yahan sirf heading 12.3 likhti hai aur foran 12.3.1 shuru kar deti hai; is heading ke neeche kitab ka apna koi text nahin hai. Yeh chhota sa taaruf (introduction) hamari taraf se hai, taa ke aap ko pehle se pata ho ke is section mein hum kahan ja rahe hain.
Ab tak (12.1 aur 12.2 mein) hum \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) nikaal rahe the, yani \(x\) ko \(c\) ke qareeb le ja rahe the, dono taraf se ek saath: baayen (left) se bhi aur daayen (right) se bhi. Ab hum limit ko ek bohat qudrati sawal ke jawab ke liye istemal karenge: kya kisi function ka graph point \(x = c\) par bina toote guzarta hai, ya wahan koi darar (break) hai?

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Pehle in do lafzon ka matlab samajh lijiye:
Continuous (musalsal, bina toote): function \(x = c\) par continuous hai jab us ka graph \(x = c\) par bina kisi break ke guzarta hai. Yani aap pencil uthaye baghair wahan se line kheench sakte hain.
Discontinuous (toota hua): function \(x = c\) par discontinuous hai jab wahan graph toot jata hai. Yeh teen tarah ho sakta hai: graph mein ek hole (soorakh, ek point ghayab), ek jump (chhalaang, dono hisse aapas mein nahin milte), ya ek akela point jo baqi curve se hat kar rakha ho.
Rozmarra ki misaal: kamre ka temperature din bhar aahista aahista badalta hai; 10 baje 25 degree tha to 10 baj kar ek second par bhi taqreeban 25 hi hoga. Yeh continuous hai. Lekin parking ki fees dekhiye: do ghante tak Rs 50, aur do ghante se ek second bhi zyada hua to seedha Rs 100. Yahan beech ki koi value nahin aati, fees chhalaang lagati hai. Yeh discontinuous hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Mobile phone ki battery ka percentage charging ke dauran 40% se 41% hota hai. Kya yeh asal mein continuous badalta hai ya screen par jump karta hai? Aur asal charge (jo battery ke andar hai) ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Is farq par sochiye: screen par number jump karta hai, magar battery ke andar charge aahista aahista, bina toote barhta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
Is section mein teen qadam hain, aur har qadam pichle par khara hai, is liye inhein isi tarteeb se parhiye:
1. 12.3.1 One-sided limits (ek taraf ki limits): left hand limit \(\lim_{x \to c^{-}} f(x)\), yani sirf baayen taraf se qareeb aana, aur right hand limit \(\lim_{x \to c^{+}} f(x)\), yani sirf daayen taraf se.
2. 12.3.2 Criterion (kasauti, parakhne ka usool): \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) tabhi exist karti hai jab dono one-sided limits exist karein aur aapas mein barabar hon.
3. 12.3.3 Continuity at a point: teen shartein (conditions): \(f(c)\) defined ho, \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exist kare, aur dono barabar hon.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Is section mein do purani skills baar baar kaam aayengi, in ko taaza kar lijiye: (1) substitution se limit nikaalna, yani theorems on limits ke mutabiq \(x\) ki jagah \(c\) rakh dena; (2) \(\frac{0}{0}\) form ko factorise kar ke common factor cancel karna, maslan \(\frac{x^{2}-9}{x-3} = x + 3\) jab \(x \ne 3\). Agar yeh do cheezein pakki hain to poora section aasaan lagega.
